items.title: After Effects Portal August 2026
items.excerpt: Rich Young's monthly After Effects roundup covers the year's big feature drops, the wave of AI and freemium competitors circling motion design, and third-party plug-in news for AE 26.3.

items.title: Gal Gadot Defends Starring in Bitcoin Movie With AI Sets and Lighting
items.excerpt: Doug Liman's $70M 'Bitcoin' used AI to build sets and lighting instead of physical production design. Gadot says her lawyers spent six months on the contract so AI touched none of her performance.

items.title: IBC 2026 preview
items.excerpt: Definition's rundown of what 45,000 media pros will see in Amsterdam, including DaVinci Resolve Studio 21's AI-assisted editorial/colour tools and agentic workflow pitches across the show floor.

items.title: Photoshop AI Assisted Editor: Markup tool arrives
items.excerpt: Adobe's AI Assisted Editor brings prompt-based editing to Photoshop in public beta, plus Markup — a tool that lets you sketch edit instructions directly onto the image instead of describing them.
items.notes: Adjacent to the Aug 30 AWN 'Adobe unveils new Photoshop AI tools' item already published; this one focuses on the Markup sketch-to-edit tool shipping in beta.

items.title: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 at IBC: Agentic Workflows, More
items.excerpt: Avid's IBC build deepens Content Core integration and agentic workflow intelligence: Ready to Edit auto-preps footage and PhraseFindAI Multicam Auto Cut places cuts on speech boundaries.
items.notes: Same release as the Aug 28 RedShark item already published; kept for the IBC/agentic-workflow angle — curator may drop as a duplicate.

items.title: Nikola Todorovic on the latest developments in Autodesk's Flow Studio
items.excerpt: A walkthrough of how Flow Studio's 3D Editor + Canvas works — blocking a shot in 3D, then finishing it on a 2D generative canvas.
items.notes: Overlaps the Aug 27 fxguide Flow Studio podcast already published; different outlet and write-up.

items.title: Eddie AI: client reviews, Resolve markers, PAYG credits
items.excerpt: Eddie AI's August update adds a client review system, DaVinci Resolve marker export and SOC 2 Type II certification alongside the new credit pricing.
items.notes: Related to the Aug 29 CineD Eddie AI pricing story already published; this covers the review/Resolve-marker side.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve 21 free webinars: full schedule and links
items.excerpt: Blackmagic's free Resolve 21 webinar series runs September to November, walking through the AI-assisted editorial, colour and Fairlight tooling session by session.

items.title: Variety and Utopai Studios to Host Future in Focus Conversations at TIFF
items.excerpt: A Sept. 12 TIFF panel with Utopai's head of production, Liz Garbus, Rebel Wilson and Basil Iwanyk on how AI and immersive tools are changing how worlds and characters get built.
